fields.Name: W2 -> S5.2
fields.Description: Gate G2.4 (phase 2, dataset W2, criterion S5.2): over W2-noise's t2 seed set, the mean of (winner's reported holdout AUC - fresh AUC) is below +0.0104 (T13; +0.0416 today, 19 of 20 above fresh). A statistical gate: the pytest node tests/gates/test_seeds400.py::test_W2_S5_2_winner_optimism runs one search per seed of the set (PS_SEED_LIMIT lowers the count for a reduced run, and the check does not assert how many seeds ran); it runs once on the final head. The node is Python, so the mutation is a substitute: it fails when the sidecar chooses its finalist by holdout AUC instead of the inner-CV rule (mean optimism >= +0.0104).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Mean winner optimism over the W2-noise t2 seed set is below +0.0104 (1 of 1 pytest case).
